title: A different bromine position
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: With peroxides HBr adds to propene through a radical pathway. Bromine attaches to the terminal carbon, giving mainly 1-bromopropane.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of propene under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Propene is treated with HBr in the presence of peroxides. Which major organic product forms after workup? With peroxides HBr adds to propene through a radical pathway. Bromine attaches to the terminal carbon, giving mainly 1-bromopropane.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
